tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dag snang mi tra'i tshe dkar phyi sgrub kyi tshe dbang bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ tshe~X mtha' yas pa'i go 'phang sgru~Xb pa'i thabs/ /ye~X shesa~X rdo rje snyinga~X po~X mchog gi lam/ /stsol mdzad bla ma 'chi med mgon po la/ /gus pas btud nas tshe dbang cho ga dbye/ /de la 'dir pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i zab gter grub chen mi tra'i snying thig las byung ba'i tshe sgrub ye shes snying po dang 'brel bar byin rlabs tshe dbang bgyi ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham bkod dang*/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ byin rlabs tshe dbang gi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ stegs kyi khar me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'am rgyas par spro na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar bum pa chas ldan sku tsag gi brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ rgyab tu tshe mda'/ mdun du mchod gtor bcas kyi mtha' phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yang las bum nas bzed ḍa ma ru rdor dril sogs 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ las byang gis bdag mdun dbyer med dam tha dad gang mos su bsgrubs nas bum pa gnyis spyi ltar dang*/ tshe 'gug mchod bstod bka' gter srung gi gtor 'bul ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang len pa bcas spyi ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ slob ma rnams la sgo drung du khrus byas phyag 'tshal gral la 'khod pa la bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom kun slong bcos pa dang chos bshad tshe sgrub dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus ci rigs brjod mthar/ ji skad du/ rang gter thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od kyi snying po'i lung byang las/ yab gcig khri srong lha sras mchog grub rje'i: zung 'jug rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i rang mdangs shig: mdo khams shar du lcags khams 'brug gi lo: bka' bab bdun ldan rig rtsal thod rgal 'chang : brtul zhugs zil ldan dpa' bo stag sham can: o rgyan thugs sras pad+ma'i ming can la: ye shes mkha' 'gros gter kha dngos su sprad: ces sogs dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po'i rdo rje'i lung gi lan brgyar bsngags pa/

'jam dpal rdo rje chos rgyal tshul can khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam par rol pa/ gter chen rkyang pa'i skye ba brgyud ma bcu gsum sogs zab gter rgya mtshor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rnam rol du ma rim dang gcig char snang ba sogs kyis snyig ma'i 'gro don rgya cher mdzad pa/ gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'am pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la/ bka' ma dang*/ sa gter dang*/ yang gter dang*/ dgongs gter dang*/ rjes dran dang*/ dag snang dang*/ snyan brgyud de snga 'gyur bka' bab chen po bdun las byung ba'i chos sde nam mkha'i mdzod ltar bzhugs pa'i nang tshan 'dir dag snang snyan brgyud kyi chos sde grub chen mi tra'i snying thig las byung ba'i tshe sgrub ye shes snying po'i phyi sgrub dang 'brel bar tshe dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod pas mtshams sbyar te maṇ+ḍal 'bul du 'jug go/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung pa can/ sogs lan gsum/ de nas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyi dmigs pa spyi ltar gsal btab te rgyun bshags gang 'os shig lan gsum bya/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i slad du khyed rang lus gnad/ ces pa nas bsang sbyang yan spyi ltar byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad bsal ba sogs don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa/ sku mdog ston ga'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas tshe bum 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ 'od zer gyi gzi brjid lham mer gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i a yig dkar po dang*/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa gsum lha tshogs thams cad bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i rnam par byon pa dang dkyil 'khor ba'i thugs ka nas kyang rang 'dra dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rang la sib sib thim pas gnyis su med par byin gyis rlob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la spos rol dang bcas te bab drug dang*/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ.ā we sha ya a āḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes bzla/ de ltar ye shes phab pa de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag te brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de nas tshe 'gug pa'i dmigs pa spyi ltar gsal la mda' dar g.yob cing*/ aḥ gdod ma'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das: sogs kyis tshe 'gug bya/ de nas tshe dbang dngos bzhi'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ye shes chen po tshe yi bdag: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag 'chi med thob bya'i phyir: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub stsol: rgyud sbyang ye shes dbab cing brtan: zhes pa gong du song bas chog go /mchan/ de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag oṃ: bkra shis bum pa'i gzhal yas na: tshe dpag med mgon lha tshogs bzhugs: 'od zhu bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku thob shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag cing sbyin: āḥ rang byung rdo rje'i ka pā lar: byang chub sems kyi bcud kyis gtam: bde stong rol pa'i dbang bskur bas: mi shig rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tshe ril snying gar gtugs cing sbyin: hūm̐ḥ 'khor 'das dwang ma kun bsdus pa'i:

ye shes mchog gi dam tshig rdzas: ra sa ya na'i dbang bskur bas: 'od gsal rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shis brjod sngags kyis brtan par bya: de ltar snod ldan slob ma la: dbang gi mchog 'di sus bskur ba: bar chad zhi zhing tshe bsod 'phel: mthar thug pad+ma can du skye: gu h+ya sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pas me tog 'thor te/ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sku: gdod ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: tshe dpag med pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bstod pa bkra shis su bsgyur ba dang*/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes brjod pas brtan par bya zhing spro na rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas rtags spyi ltar bskur zhing shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ mjug tu dam tshig khas len maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul rnams dang sgrub thabs kyi mjug chog rnams spyi ltar bya'o/ thuba~X bstana~X rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ong ba'i/ /le~Xgs bsha~Xd phrin chog bzanga~X po'i nora~X bu~X 'dir/ /rgyal bstana~X 'dzina~X skyong spel ba'i 'od 'phro bzhin/ /gzha~Xn pha~Xn 'dod rgu mtha~X' ya~Xs char 'bebs shog /pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i dag snang grub chen mi tra'i snying thig gi tshe sgrub ye shes snying po'i le'u tshan no/ /dge'o// //
